summary.text: Rachel Baker is a Democratic state representative from Ohio who has represented District 27 since January 1, 2023, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A nurse and researcher, she is the ranking member of the House Medicaid Committee.

paragraphs.text: Rachel Baker lives in Anderson Township, Ohio, according to Ballotpedia.

She earned a bachelor's degree in nursing from the University of Cincinnati in 1996, a master's degree in social work from the University of Michigan in 1999, and a Ph.D. in nursing from the University of Cincinnati in 2003.
Her career experience includes working as a nurse researcher and as an adjunct instructor for graduate nursing students at several universities.
Baker succeeded Tom Brinkman Jr. (R) in the Ohio House of Representatives and assumed office on January 1, 2023.
In the 2025-2026 session she serves on the House Finance and House Health committees and is the ranking member of the Medicaid Committee.
Nancy Aichholz (R) is the other candidate in the November 3, 2026 general election.
